lesson.title: Educational access and assessment
lesson.summary: Recognise educational admission and learning-outcome functions at every institutional level.

prerequisites.reason: The learner must distinguish a listed-use match from the product route.

blocks: The **educational-access use** includes determining access or admission, or assigning people to educational and vocational-training institutions at all levels. It is not limited to universities.

Northbridge's fictional training college considers an admissions assistant recommending which applicants enter a programme. Identify that concrete purpose rather than classifying all learning software alike.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex III 3(a), 3(b); Article 6(2), 6(3)

blocks: The **learning-outcome use** includes evaluating learning outcomes in those institutions, including when the outcomes steer a person's learning process.
An AI assessor evaluating a student's work and changing the next learning path needs comparison with point 3(b). A system's feedback being called 'helpful' does not eliminate the evaluation function.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex III 3(a), 3(b); Article 6(2), 6(3)

blocks: These listed purposes differ from simply organising administrative documents or providing general information. The exact intended institutional use is decisive.

If a claimed administrative tool actually evaluates applications or work, record that. If it only formats a file, examine the actual narrow function; a later lesson applies the full paragraph 3 derogation rather than granting one from this description.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex III 3(a), 3(b); Article 6(2), 6(3)

blocks: Northbridge describes admissions and learning evaluation separately even when one platform performs both. Record the institutional context, input, output and how the result is used.
Annex III listing establishes the route needing analysis. Complete the prohibition, paragraph 3, profiling, scope and date checks before claiming a complete outcome.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Annex III 3(a), 3(b); Article 6(2), 6(3)

options.reason: Point 3(a) includes vocational institutions at all levels.

options.reason: The stated function recommends admission, not just storage.
